column3: the real-tree cases read the whole of OspreyFlow_Core at HEAD through git ls-tree and git cat-file (read-only), run the script's no-React step on an extracted archive in a temporary folder, and read OspreyFlow_Core/scripts/manifest_areas.toml and the release workflow at HEAD; one case walks the working tree's OspreyFlow_Core/apps/pages and OspreyFlow_Core/packages/glass-shared with rglob into a temporary repository; every other case builds its own git repositories in tmp_path
